# Oxidized

Files of [Oxidized](https://github.com/ytti/oxidized) at commit `d7f51c2f0bdb77106ea8c058ed98a5a9bcfb68d7`, unmodified and at their paths in that repository, under the Apache License 2.0 in [LICENSE](LICENSE). glazed's specs use them:

- `lib/oxidized/model/{aireos,junos}.rb`: models that the glazed-oxidized specs run.
- `spec/model/data/*:simulation.yaml`: device simulations that glazed's dialect specs replay, with additions in `glazed/spec/fixtures/dialects`.

Keep them unmodified. To update, copy the files from a newer commit and change the commit above.
